name: Program V3

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.notes: Rest: 90-120. RIR target: sets 1-2: 2-3 RIR; last set 1-2 RIR. Anchor. Full depth you own; 2-3 s lowering. Baseline: 2026-10-06: 180x12 x3 @ RIR 3/3/3. Derivation: R1: in range at RIR 3 -> hold, add reps. First session: 180 x 13-15. App key: leg press.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 180 lb. First session: 180 x 13-15.

exercises.name: Lying or seated leg curl
exercises.notes: Rest: 60-90. RIR target: 2-3 RIR, cap 1 RIR. Seated curl preferred (lengthened hamstring) if available. Baseline: 2026-10-06: 80x12 @ RIR 3/2/0. Derivation: R4: a set hit 0 RIR -> hold load, cap at 1 RIR, full rest. First session: 80 x 12-14. App key: leg curl.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 80 lb. First session: 80 x 12-14.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.notes: Rest: 90. RIR target: 2-3 RIR; last set 1-2. Baseline: 2026-09-30: 55x10 @ RIR 3/2. Derivation: R1: in range -> hold, add reps. First session: 55 x 11-12. App key: chest-supported row.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 55 lb. First session: 55 x 11-12.

exercises.name: CC squat ladder - step 2 Jackknife squat
exercises.notes: Rest: 60. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Bodyweight; doubles as hip mobility. Skip if over 45 min. Baseline: V2 ladder step 2 (no newer CC event visible). Derivation: CC rule: advance after 2 consecutive sessions at top of step range <=2 RIR. First session: 2 x top of range. App key: cc squat.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 0 (bodyweight). First session: 2 x top of range.
substitutions: regress to step 1 if form breaks

conditioning.description: 8 min steady: bike or incline walk, RPE 5-6/10. Placement: FIRST. Minimum if late: 5 min. Log as: "bike 8 min steady". Then mobility (5 min, before lifting): 5 min mobility (hips/hamstrings): 90/90 hip switches 2x6/side, half-kneeling hip-flexor stretch 2x30 s/side, active straight-leg raise 2x8/side.

exercises.name: Chest press machine
exercises.notes: Rest: 90-120. RIR target: 2-3 RIR; last set 1-2. Anchor. Baseline: 2026-10-07: 100x12 @ RIR 3/3/1. Derivation: R2 would allow +5; held at 100 for the first V3 week (fresh start, intro week); auto-check after set 1. First session: 100 x 12; if set 1 is 12 @ RIR >=4 go 105. App key: chest press.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 100 lb. First session: 100 x 12; if set 1 is 12 @ RIR >=4 go 105.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown (neutral or long bar)
exercises.notes: Rest: 60-90. RIR target: 2 RIR. Baseline: 2026-09-30: 85x10 @ RIR 3/3. Derivation: R1: hold, add reps. First session: 85 x 11-12. App key: lat pulldown.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 85 lb. First session: 85 x 11-12.

exercises.name: Overhead press machine
exercises.notes: Rest: 75-90. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Baseline: 2026-10-07: 90x12 @ RIR 3/2. Derivation: R1: top of range at RIR 2-3 -> hold; +5 when both sets 12 @ <=2. First session: 90 x 12. App key: overhead press.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 90 lb. First session: 90 x 12.

exercises.name: Cable or DB curl
exercises.notes: Rest: 60 after each pair. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Baseline: Curl: no logged history. Pressdown 2026-10-07: 140x12 @ RIR 2. Derivation: Curl R6 pick by feel (~17-rep weight, settle at 2-3 RIR); pressdown R1 hold, add reps. First session: curl by feel; pressdown 140 x 13-15. App key: superset curl + pressdown. Superset part 1 of 2; rest 60 s after each pair.
exercises.load_note: Start load: pick by feel (~17-rep weight). First session: curl by feel; pressdown 140 x 13-15.

exercises.name: Triceps pressdown
exercises.notes: Rest: 60 after each pair. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Baseline: Curl: no logged history. Pressdown 2026-10-07: 140x12 @ RIR 2. Derivation: Curl R6 pick by feel (~17-rep weight, settle at 2-3 RIR); pressdown R1 hold, add reps. First session: curl by feel; pressdown 140 x 13-15. App key: superset curl + pressdown. Superset part 2 of 2; rest 60 s after each pair.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 140 lb. First session: curl by feel; pressdown 140 x 13-15.

exercises.name: CC leg raise ladder - step 1 Knee tuck
exercises.notes: Rest: 45-60. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Skip if over 45 min. Baseline: 2026-09-15: 0x10 @ RIR 3. Derivation: CC rule. First session: 2 x 12+. App key: cc leg raise.

conditioning.description: 8 min steady: bike or incline walk, RPE 5-6/10. Placement: FIRST. Minimum if late: 5 min. Log as: "incline walk 8 min steady". Then mobility (4 min, before lifting): 4 min: hip-flexor stretch 2x30 s/side, thoracic open-book 2x6/side, active straight-leg raise 2x8/side.

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
exercises.notes: Rest: 90-120. RIR target: set 1 ~3 RIR; sets 2-3 2 RIR. Anchor. Slow, deep hip hinge = loaded hamstring/hip mobility. Baseline: 2026-09-30: 35x12 x3 @ RIR 3. Derivation: R1: top of range but RIR 3 (not <=2) -> hold; +5 when 12s at <=2 RIR. First session: 35 x 12 @ 2 RIR. App key: cable pull-through.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 35 lb. First session: 35 x 12 @ 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Hip thrust machine / glute drive
exercises.notes: Rest: 90. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Baseline: 2026-09-24: 50x10 @ RIR 3 x2 (older, V1). Derivation: R1: hold, add reps; auto-check after set 1. First session: 50 x 12-15. App key: hip thrust.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 50 lb. First session: 50 x 12-15.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.notes: Rest: 60-90. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Baseline: 2026-10-06: 80x12 @ RIR 3/3. Derivation: R1: hold, add reps. First session: 80 x 13-15. App key: leg extension.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 80 lb. First session: 80 x 13-15.

exercises.name: CC bridge ladder - step 1 Short bridge
exercises.notes: Rest: 60-90. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Hip extension through full range. Baseline: 2026-09-21: 0x8 @ RIR 2. Derivation: CC rule. First session: 2 x 10+. App key: cc bridge.

conditioning.description: 12 min bike: 2 easy + 5 x (1 min hard RPE 7-8 / 1 min easy). Placement: FIRST. Minimum if late: 2 easy + 3 rounds. Log as: "bike 12 min intervals". Then mobility (4 min, before lifting): 5 min mobility (hamstrings/hips): seated or standing hamstring stretch 2x30 s/side, adductor rock-back 2x8, glute bridge hold 2x20 s.

exercises.name: Incline chest press machine
exercises.notes: Rest: 90. RIR target: 2-3 RIR; last set 1-2. Baseline: 2026-10-01: 100x12 x3 @ RIR 3. Derivation: R1: top of range at RIR 3 -> hold, last set to 2 RIR; +5 when 12s at <=2. First session: 100 x 12, last set 2 RIR. App key: incline chest press.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 100 lb. First session: 100 x 12, last set 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck / rear-delt machine
exercises.notes: Rest: 60-75. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Baseline: 2026-10-01: 15x12 x3 @ RIR 3. Derivation: R1: hold, add reps. First session: 15 x 13-15. App key: reverse pec deck.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 15 lb. First session: 15 x 13-15.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.notes: Rest: 60. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Baseline: 2026-10-01: 15x12 x2 @ RIR 3. Derivation: R1: hold, add reps. First session: 15 x 13-15. App key: cable lateral raise.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 15 lb. First session: 15 x 13-15.

exercises.name: Cable or DB curl
exercises.notes: Rest: 60 after each pair. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Baseline: Curl: no logged history. OH ext 2026-10-07: 20x10 @ RIR 2. Derivation: Curl R6 pick by feel; OH ext R1 hold, add reps. First session: curl by feel; OH ext 20 x 11-13. App key: superset curl + overhead ext. Superset part 1 of 2; rest 60 s after each pair.
exercises.load_note: Start load: pick by feel (~17-rep weight). First session: curl by feel; OH ext 20 x 11-13.

exercises.name: Overhead triceps extension (cable or DB)
exercises.notes: Rest: 60 after each pair. RIR target: 2-3 RIR. Baseline: Curl: no logged history. OH ext 2026-10-07: 20x10 @ RIR 2. Derivation: Curl R6 pick by feel; OH ext R1 hold, add reps. First session: curl by feel; OH ext 20 x 11-13. App key: superset curl + overhead ext. Superset part 2 of 2; rest 60 s after each pair.
exercises.load_note: Start load: 20 lb. First session: curl by feel; OH ext 20 x 11-13.

conditioning.description: 10 min steady: incline walk or bike, RPE 5-6/10. Placement: FIRST. Minimum if late: 5 min. Log as: "incline walk 10 min steady". Then mobility (4 min, before lifting): 4 min: 90/90 hip switches 2x6/side, hamstring stretch 2x30 s/side.

body.notes: program-v3, approved 2026-10-15, starts Mon 2026-10-19 (activation is manual; V2 stays active until then). Units: lb. RIR primary. 4 days: Mon Lower A, Tue Upper A, Thu Lower B, Fri Upper B. <=45 min: conditioning first, 4-5 min hip/hamstring mobility, then lifting. 10k steps daily; CC ladders kept. Week 1 (10/19-10/25) = intro/reduction week (anchors 2 sets, accessories 1-2, 3-4 RIR); full progression from 10/26; reduction week 6 (11/23-11/29), review 11/29. Progression as V2 (double progression, +5 lb, -5 after two misses below range). Weight via Apple Health. Order beats calendar; make-up Wed or Sat.

change_reason: Seeded from approved Program V3 (2026-10-15). 4-day fat-loss + mobility restart; starts Mon 2026-10-19. Loaded as draft; activate on 10/19.
